note: Paper simulation only; no real orders. Strict profit-only selling: no sale unless at least 1 TRY estimated net profit remains after entry and exit fees. No stop-loss; losing positions can remain open and tie up capital. FX and crypto quote sources can differ, fills are simulated, and 5-minute candles may miss intrabar order; a 1% stop-loss is checked on available candle lows; simulated fills can differ from real market prices.
